key_reasoning.reason: Multi-repo changes with distinct content across 2 repos — scope scored additively. Six touchpoints shipped: the shared user_type validator module (duplicated verbatim in both repos, following the pre-existing zero-coupling convention), PersonalProjectService, AuthenticationService, RegistrationService, UserProfileService (pass-through), and the enterprise KeycloakMigrationCoordinator. That meets the '4+ components, multiple subsystems' criterion even though every individual touch was a 1-3 line guard clause.

Diffstat reports 14 files changed total (10 base repo, 4 enterprise repo), mapping to the XL band (11-15) under the actual-mode file-count rule. Nearly all 14 are modified files, not new ones (8 of 14 are test files) — breadth of touched files, not new-subsystem creation, drives this score.

Dropped from the initial L(4) to S(2): the backfill/cleanup question that drove the initial ambiguity score was scoped out before implementation. The one remaining decision — guard at each call site vs. extend ensure_personal_project_async's signature — resolved cleanly (guards added at call sites; reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change gained a required user_type parameter).
